messages:
maria: Quick proposal — can we move to tiered error-budget notifications for GPU pools? I’m seeing noisy pages for 95th latency blips that don't affect capacity but keep waking oncall.
kevin: +1, been meaning to suggest thresholds by impact tier. e.g., page at P0 for model-serving outage, P2 for latency >SLO for 10m, Slack-only for brief spikes.
tasha: Curious about cost signal too — we want alerting that considers both SLO burn and spend anomalies. like if errorbudget is low but cost is spiking, different runbook.
maria: Exactly. My thinking: compute a composite indicator in Prometheus: slo_burn_rate + normalized_cost_spike and use it for escalations. keep pure saturation alerts separate.
devon: Could you sketch Grafana/Alertmanager flow? I want avoid duplicating alerts across regions and on dedicated vs shared pools.
maria: Rough plan:
- base SLI rules per pool (latency/success/saturation)
- roll up to regional composite with weights (prod>staging)
- composite -> classification: "service-impacting" vs "cost-only" vs "transient"
- notification policy: page / slack / ticket depending on class and remaining EB
kevin: For rules, maybe use this notifier logic (pseudo):
```
# PromQL-ish
composite = sum_over_pools( burn_rate * pool_weight )
cost_signal = increase(gpu_hour_cost[15m]) / avg_cost_baseline
notify_level = if(composite > 0.2 && cost_signal > 0.3, "pager" , if(composite>0.1, "slack", "none"))
```
Not exact syntax but shows idea.
tasha: Need to be careful with baselines — cost spikes around large retrains will look like incidents but are expected. add tags to ignore planned jobs.
devon: Also: make sure Alertmanager routes include dedupe and group_by pool+region so we don't page for every shard. And set a cool-down for noise: require sustained 5m.
maria: Agreed. I'll put together a PoC dashboard and the Alertmanager route. will include a small runbook: when composite->pager, check model-queue length, GPU util, qps, and recent deploys.
alerts-bot: Deploy scheduled: grafana/dashboard/proto-composite -> staging at 2026-04-02 04:00 UTC :bell:
kevin: Nice. Can you include a lightweight daily report for EB consumption per customer tier? Ops wants to track which tenants are burning budgets fastest.
maria: Will do. Plan: PoC next week, test with simulated blips, and then gradual rollout to prod. any objections?
tasha: No objections. please add me to the doc for cost exclusion rules.
devon: I can help with Alertmanager routes. +1 to gradual rollout.
maria: Thanks — will post the dashboard link when ready. :thumbsup:
